global_goal: Build a dashboard module that displays agent stability and hunger in real-time via an API hook.
current_performative: You can create a component called `aggregation_utils` for this task. It will manage data stored by the agent's state machine and provide an API hook that displays the safety ratings in real-time via an API hook. The function should return the safety rating as a JSON string, which can be used to display it on the dashboard of the agent.
